blocks.text: Do you need a water softener in Terrell Hills, TX? Hard water can damage pipes, appliances, and sometimes even your health. Hard water is generally considered safe for drinking, but the minerals can irritate sensitive skin. The extra minerals in hard water can remove moisture from your skin and hair. This can leave you with itchy, flaky skin or dry hair. Many people find that softening their home’s water helps improve these issues. If health is a priority, consider water filtration services from Rosenberg Plumbing & Air.

Filtration helps remove heavy metals, viruses, bacteria, and other unwanted contaminants. We can install filtration on your sink or fridge if you are concerned about the water your family drinks. Whole-home filtration is also an option. With whole-home filtration, you can wash your hands and bathe knowing your water is clean. There are many advantages associated with softening and filtration. Our team can help you decide which option is best for your home.
Installing a Water Softener or Filtration System

Installing a water softener or filtration system is not a DIY project. One wrong twist of the wrench can leave you with a plumbing disaster! Luckily, you can count on the professionals at Rosenberg Plumbing & Air for help with softening and filtration, with proper installation and high-quality work.

A filtration system captures large particles of dirt and debris as they travel through your water system. This is done by using different filters, such as carbon filters or UV filters. A softening system uses an ion exchange process. Simply put, hard minerals get replaced by softer ones when ions are exchanged.

items: Fewer contaminants in your water supply
Reduced risk of damage to sinks and appliances
Better-tasting water for cooking and drinking

blocks.text: If you decide a filtration system isn’t the right choice for your family, consider softening your water. Softened water is less abrasive on your plumbing system and can extend the life of your appliances. You may also notice less residue on your clothes, dishes, and body after using softened water. The professionals at Rosenberg Plumbing & Air can test your water and explain the difference between softening and filtration. That way, you can decide which one your family needs.
